heading: Projects
subtitle: A selection of projects I've built and contributed to.

items.title: Telegram GPT
items.description: A LangGraph-powered Telegram agent that lives in group chats as an assistant — with tool use, persistent memory, and multi-step reasoning.

items.title: VibePlan
items.description: An AI-powered itinerary planner for Singapore that scrapes live social media data to recommend activities based on vibe, budget, and real-time trends.

items.title: Telegram Relay Server
items.description: A C++17 proxy in front of the Telegram Bot API with token-bucket rate limiting, priority lanes for noisy chats, and backpressure that returns 503s instead of getting a bot throttled.

items.title: Cloom
items.description: A native macOS screen recorder with a draggable webcam bubble, multi-track audio, and automatic 1080p export, built with no external dependencies.

items.title: MoneyGo
items.description: A cross-platform personal finance mobile app featuring AI receipt scanning, expense tracking, and data visualization.

items.title: Open Research
items.description: An agentic hackathon ideation tool that profiles sponsors, cross-references prior Devpost and GitHub projects, and streams back ranked idea briefs with verified citations.

items.title: Kanye Soundboard
items.description: A 30-pad sampler for playing with sounds from Runaway and Stronger, with keyboard controls and a built-in instrumental deck. A fun, non-commercial side project.

items.title: chud
items.description: An autonomous dating intern that swipes, chats in your tone, and plans dates so you can keep coding. A 'Sup Hackathon 2026 entry that almost worked.

items.title: Felix's Calendar Agent
items.description: A Telegram agent that creates, edits, and deletes Google Calendar events from natural language or photos of flyers, with confirm/cancel buttons for every staged change.

items.title: Lyra AI
items.description: A music therapy platform for seniors with Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, and stroke, combining personalised AI-generated songs with adaptive piano-tile exercises. Built for Hack N Roll 2026.

items.title: GrantAI
items.description: A grant discovery engine for nonprofits that matches project ideas to funding through pgvector semantic search and LLM fit analysis, with a chatbot to explain each grant.

items.title: NUS GPA Calculator
items.description: A rich academic tracking tool for NUS students to compute CAP/GPA, featuring CSV import/export, semester filtering, and local storage persistence.

items.title: Raffles Hall Confessions Bot
items.description: A Telegram bot facilitating anonymous confessions posted to a channel with public comment threads, managing user anonymity.

items.title: NotiflyMeBot
items.description: A Telegram reminder bot that turns plain English like 'tomorrow at 3pm' into a scheduled alert, using Groq to parse dates and Celery workers to deliver reminders on time.

items.title: Heartfelt Support Bot
items.description: An anonymous Telegram bot connecting users with support members while maintaining complete privacy for both parties via masked identities.

items.title: Tze Foong's Timer
items.description: A URL-based timer and stopwatch application allowing instant configuration via URL paths with a clean, responsive Tailwind UI.
